category_edits.rationale: Replace negative-score weighting with a uniform unit-margin pairwise softplus loss. Each valid target has one existing sampled negative, so averaging valid pairs implements the requested per-target mean across all four datasets.

edits.find:
valid_pos = pos_scores[mask]
    valid_neg = neg_scores[mask]
    weights = torch.softmax(valid_neg.detach(), dim=0)
    pairwise_loss = torch.nn.functional.softplus(valid_neg - valid_pos)
    return (weights * pairwise_loss).sum()
edits.replace:
valid_pos = pos_scores[mask]
    valid_neg = neg_scores[mask]
    pairwise_loss = torch.nn.functional.softplus(1.0 + valid_neg - valid_pos)
    return pairwise_loss.mean()

change_summary: Apply unit-margin pairwise softplus loss to all four category models, preserving masking, sampling, GRU architecture, inference, and training settings.
